availability.pausedHint: Finish your own; no new ones arrive

hero.eyebrow: Banking customer service · Spanish and Portuguese
hero.lead: Chatquiry resolves repeatable requests with a human tone, and hands every sensitive case to your team with the facts already verified. It connects to the channels your customers already use and the systems your bank already has. It replaces no one: it gives every agent more reach.

philosophy.p1Text: Where is my transfer? What is this charge? Requests that take hours of your team's time today get solved instantly, with the customer's real data.
philosophy.p2Text: Fraud, large amounts, upset customers: the AI doesn't improvise. It passes the conversation to an agent with full context, so the customer repeats nothing.
philosophy.p3Text: Every answer rests on records and rules, not on the model's intuition. Every action lands in a trace anyone on the team can read.

how.title: Understand, decide, act, verify, hand off.
how.s1Text: Detects language, intent and manipulation attempts before the message reaches the model.
how.s2Text: Bank rules, outside the model, decide what can and cannot be answered.
how.s3Text: Reads only the signed-in customer's data and asks for an explicit “yes” before any action.
how.s4Text: It only states what it confirmed in the records. If it can't check it, it doesn't claim it.
how.s5Text: When a person is needed, it passes facts, actions taken and what's still open.
how.statesTitle: Your team sees the state at a glance

connect.eyebrow: Connects to what you already have
connect.title: Your customers install nothing and create no accounts. Chatquiry reaches the chat they already use.
connect.c2: Chat in the bank's app or website
connect.hub: One API key. Your rules, your tools, your team.

demo.customerText: A test channel to live the experience: ask about a transfer or a strange charge in Spanish or Portuguese.
demo.agentText: Receives the conversations that need human judgment, with a copilot that summarizes, verifies and suggests.
demo.adminText: Defines AI profiles, tools and rules, and sees the whole operation: conversations, metrics and audit.

landing.footerRight: Synthetic data · no real credit decisions or money movement

login.lead: Every conversation arrives with verified facts, recorded actions and what's left to resolve.
login.title: Sign in
login.testChatNote: The test chat lives inside the workspace: sign in to talk to the assistant as if you were a customer.
login.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.returnConfirm: {ai} will pick up the conversation with full context. Use it when what's open no longer needs human judgment.
conversations.resolveConfirm: The customer sees a friendly close and the conversation moves to Resolved. It is recorded in the audit log.
conversations.supervision: Supervision mode: you can read the whole conversation; agents reply.
conversations.sentMessage: Sending through the customer's channel is not implemented yet.

copilot.label: Copilot
copilot.noHandoff: The AI is handling this conversation. There is no handoff.

customers.title: Customers
customers.note: Only customers with Chatquiry conversations are listed. General search lives in the bank's core system.
customers.source: Source: transactions (serving subset) · amounts in local currency · synthetic datathon data

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.logNote: Append-only log: nobody edits it, neither the AI nor staff.

traces.title: Trace
traces.lead: Execution records, rules and sources. It contains no hidden model reasoning.

testChat.title: Test chat
testChat.lead: Talk to the assistant the way a customer would. In production the customer arrives through WhatsApp, the widget or the API, already identified by the channel.
testChat.auditNote: Every test conversation is recorded in the audit log under your user. The server asserts the customer's identity, never the browser.
testChat.empty: Write as a customer and you'll see every step here: filters, signals, rules, tools, policies and verification.
testChat.idle: Execution records, not hidden model reasoning.

operations.title: Operations
operations.noData: No data yet · filled by the evaluation
operations.offlineNote: Offline measurement on held-out test cases. Not a measured production improvement.

audit.title: Audit
audit.exportAction: Export the filtered audit log to CSV
audit.searchPlaceholder: Search action, conversation, customer or ID

permission.customer_confirmHint: Stays pending until the customer confirms in writing.
permission.human_onlyHint: No AI has it; only the agent's copilot.

departments.title: Map and departments
departments.lead: How a message travels: it enters through a channel, the intake filter understands it, rules route it, and a department handles it with its AI and its human team.
departments.deleteConsequence: Rules that land here will have no destination until you reassign them.

profiles.title: AI profiles
profiles.lead: Each profile is an AI “employee”: its voice, its model, its tools and when it hands the conversation to a person. Open one to see every detail.
profiles.deleteConsequence: Its departments will have no AI and new conversations will go straight to people.
profiles.handoffWhen: Hands off to a person when
profiles.handoffNote: The intake filter and policies evaluate these conditions; the model can't skip them.
profiles.disclosureHint: One line at the start of the chat

tools.title: Tools and permissions
tools.lead: What the AI and the team can do on the bank's systems. Permissions are enforced on the server, outside the model: model text never opens a door.
tools.schemaNote: The schema is validated before running; invalid input goes back to the model as an error.
tools.newNote: Register a connector operation so an AI profile or the team can use it.
tools.deleteConsequence: Profiles that use it will lose it from their next conversation.

routing.title: Routing
routing.lead: Rules are evaluated in order over the intake filter's signals; the first match decides. They're deterministic: the same message always goes to the same place.
routing.fallback: If no rule matches, the assistant asks the customer to clarify instead of guessing.
routing.thresholdsNote: Thresholds chosen on validation to avoid missing necessary handoffs.
routing.examples: How it decides · examples from the test chat
routing.deleteConsequence: Messages that matched will fall through to the next rule in order.

guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.lead: Filters that check every customer message and every reply before it goes out. They live outside the model, so a manipulation attempt can't switch them off.
guardrails.promptAttackHint: Detects attempts to change the assistant's instructions (“ignore your rules…”), in Spanish and Portuguese.
guardrails.groundingHint: A reply with amounts, IDs or statuses that don't appear in tool results is regenerated or replaced with a safe reply.
guardrails.engineHint: Applied to the customer's input and the AI's output, with the same record in the trace.
guardrails.piiNote: Mask: the data arrives as ••••. Block: the message doesn't go through and the customer is asked not to share it.
guardrails.blockedPreview: What the customer sees when blocked
guardrails.blockedNote: Same human tone: no mention of filters or internal rules.
guardrails.testAction: Test a message against the guardrail
guardrails.editNote: Changes create a new version; the previous one stays available to roll back.

policies.title: Policies
policies.lead: The business rules that decide: deadlines, limits and when a person steps in. They're versioned code with test cases; the AI only explains the decision, never invents it.
policies.synthetic: Synthetic policies created for the prototype. A real bank connects its approved rules here.
policies.versionNote: Editing a policy creates a new version; it only activates if its test cases pass.
policies.archiveConsequence: Rules and profiles that use it will stop applying it.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.lead: Where your customers come in and which bank systems Chatquiry can read. One API key per environment; rules and teams live in the workspace.
integrations.keyNote: The key is shown only once when created; keep it in your secrets manager.
integrations.rotateConfirm: A new key will be issued and the current one stops working in 24 hours.
integrations.revokeConsequence: Integrations that use it will stop working immediately.
integrations.identityText: The channel provides it: your bank signs a token for a customer already signed in to its app, or WhatsApp links the verified number. Sensitive actions require a one-time code.
integrations.identityNote: An ID number alone never unlocks data.
integrations.connectorsNote: Each connector declares which tools it exposes and with what permission: read, needs the customer's “yes”, or human only.

users.title: Users and roles
users.lead: Who works in the operation, on which team, with which languages and skills. Routing uses this to choose who gets each conversation.
users.note: An administrator creates accounts; there's no open sign-up. Passwords are hashed. Each person edits their photo, display name and greeting in their profile.
users.newNote: The person gets an email to set their password. There's no open sign-up.
users.deactivateConsequence: They won't be able to sign in and their open conversations will be reassigned.

profile.title: My profile
profile.lead: What you decide about how customers see you, how Chatquiry notifies you and how the interface looks. Your role, team and shift are set by administration.
profile.photoFormats: JPG, PNG or WebP. Cropped to a square.
profile.errPhotoType: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
profile.errPhotoSize: The image must be under 5 MB.
profile.displayNameHint: Just your first name, the way you'd introduce yourself on the phone.
profile.greeting: Greeting when you take a conversation
profile.greetingHint: The copilot uses it as the first suggestion and translates it to the customer's language. {n}/280
profile.nNewHandoff: When a conversation is assigned to me
profile.interfaceHint: Saved to your profile and applied on all your devices.
profile.assignedNote: These decide which conversations reach you (language, skill, capacity). To change them, talk to your administrator.
profile.securityNote: The identity service handles password changes and signing out other sessions.
profile.savedMessage: Your photo, display name, greeting and preferences now apply.

errors.displayName: The display name must be between 2 and 40 characters.
errors.avatar: The photo must be JPG, PNG or WebP and under 200 KB.

status.notFoundTitle: This page left without saying goodbye.
status.notFoundMessage: We searched every conversation, profile and trace. It's not here, and we checked twice.
status.recordNotFoundMessage: The ID may be misspelled or it no longer exists. Everything that does exist is one click away in the left bar.
status.forbiddenMessage: Your role doesn't include this section. Don't worry: the attempt was logged and nobody got upset.
status.errorMessage: This time it was us, not you. Nothing you did was lost: try again, and if it keeps happening, share the code with the tech team.
